answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint disposable agents to seize grading seats. Mechanism: before a seat opens, lock 1.2 POA in a cold vault for 36h and pass a zephyr-rate proof—upload a 256KB signed challenge blob to a harbor relay that returns a Merkle receipt tied to the epoch seed. Cost: stake lock plus ~0.05 POA relay fee and the 36h wait. Verify: peers match vault lock height and harbor Merkle root to the seed; mismatch rejects the seat. Fail: slash 50% of vault stake and impose a 4-epoch seat cooldown.
